cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says consumer-protection rules for digital financial services are in force; the UNCDF and BSL accounts of mobile money guidelines and complaints tracking date from 2021 and 2022.
cells.note: Stage 4c 2026-11-12: In July 2025 NatCA presented a proposed framework for digital financial services with consumer-protection provisions, set jointly with the Bank of Sierra Leone, which answers question 1. No source from the last three years shows such rules in force.
